newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks bounce back after 4 day slump.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks bounce back after 4 day slump.

text.p: The Caracas bolsa reversed a four day slump to roar ahead, as investors snapped-up underpriced shares, trader said.
"There were strong early orders for Electricidad de Caracas that woke the market, buyers emerged, and so the bolsa rose," said Activalores broker Gonzalo Alonso.
The market's 19-share .IBC index gained 3.19 percent to close at 6,147.89 points as 28 shares rose, eight fell and seven closed flat.
"Shares were attractively priced after falling so much... it was an animated session," said Cavelba broker Johann Gomez.
A total of 19.6 million shares exchanged hands, worth 4.4 billion bolivars ($9.4 million).

Heavy trade in paper and pulp company Venepal saw its B series shares up 6.00 bolivars to end at 130.00. Among other widely held stocks, Electricidad de Caracas closed up 17.25 bolivars at 520.00 bolivars, while telephone company CANTV edged up 6.00 bolivars to end at 1776.00.
